detail.text: The Detroit Pistons traded Bojan Bogdanovic and Alec Burks to the New York Knicks for Ryan Arcidiacono , Malachi Flynn , Evan Fournier , Quentin Grimes and cash. New York received a trade exception. Detroit received a trade exception.

items.title: Got Troy Brown Jr., Shake Milton, 2030 2nd for Monte Morris
items.label: OK

detail.text: The Detroit Pistons traded Monte Morris to the Minnesota Timberwolves for Troy Brown Jr. , Shake Milton and a 2030 2nd round draft pick. 2030 2nd-rd pick is MIN own Minnesota received a trade exception. Detroit received a trade exception.
